name: Nex
tagline: Claude Cowork for high-volume GTM workflows
description: Nex automates workflows like CRM clean up, large list qualification, revenue recovery, at large volumes, that break general purpose agents. Built by ex-HubSpotters who ran its three largest customer platforms and backed by HubSpot founder Dharmesh Shah.

name: Agent Builder by Airtop
tagline: Build agents that heal themselves.
description: Describe any workflow in plain English. Agent Builder compiles it into a coded automation that runs like software. When a run breaks, Airtop automatically investigates, rebuilds the step, and verifies the fix on a real test run. Airtop Agents run securely in the cloud and are up to 100x more efficient than traditional LLM-per-step AI Agents.

name: MagiCrew
tagline: Give everyone their own AI workforce in one platform
description: MagiCrew is an open-source AI Agent platform that gives everyone their own AI workforce. Instead of simply chatting with AI, deploy specialized digital workers that research, analyze, create reports, generate presentations, and complete real business tasks. With multi-agent collaboration, enterprise controls, and deliverable-ready outputs, MagiCrew helps teams turn AI from a tool they use into a workforce they can manage.

name: Omi
tagline: Ask your computer anything you saw or heard
description: Omi captures your screen and conversations, creates tasks, reminders and advice, helping you find anything you saw or discussed. Turn calls into summaries and action items, ask questions and get personalized responses! Omi is open source, local and works with your own AI keys, giving you full control over what gets recorded, paused, or deleted.

name: Atlas by World Labs
tagline: Turn text, pics, video, + 3D into camera-controlled HD video
description: Atlas is World Labs' omni world model. It takes text, images, video, and 3D, then generates camera-controlled 1440p video up to a minute, reconstructs scenes from a few photos, and simulates space-time for robotics. Early access.

name: Tabbit AI
tagline: The best AI browser built both for you and your Agents.
description: Tabbit is the AI browser that knows what you’re working on and can get the work done for you. Give it the pages, screenshots, and local files that matter, and Tabbit Agent can work across the web now or on a schedule. It delivers usable HTML, PDFs, and presentations, then saves the workflow as a Skill you can run again.

name: Higgsfield Genjutsu
tagline: Recast motion with your characters, locations & products
description: Higgsfield Genjutsu is an AI video-to-video tool for creators, influencers, and marketers who want to transform existing footage without a full reshoot. Its Motion Transfer and Object Swap features let you change characters, objects, outfits, locations, or styles while preserving the original motion, timing, and shot structure, making content variations faster and more flexible.

name: Tidy
tagline: Fix grammar in any Mac app with free on-device AI
description: Fix spelling and grammar anywhere on your Mac. Select text, press the shortcut, and the corrected version replaces it where it sits. A second shortcut strips the AI slop out of anything that reads like a machine wrote it. @Mentions, dates and times are untouched. It runs on the model built into macOS. Nothing you select is uploaded. Needs macOS 26 with Apple Intelligence.

name: Thaw
tagline: The only app that owns your whole menu bar, in and out
description: Take back your menu bar. Hide what you don't need, find anything in a keystroke, and make the bar look the way you want. Free and open source. Private by design: no tracking, no account, nothing ever leaves your Mac.

name: Readr
tagline: A free reader that answers your questions and reads aloud
description: Readr is an ebook reader you can talk to. You're reading Project Hail Mary and wonder: could Astrophage exist? Select the line and ask. The answer appears in the margin, drawn from the whole book, and says when it's pulling from real science instead. Lost the thread? Ask for a recap of what you've read so far, no spoilers. Press Listen and a natural voice reads from your page, on your device, no cap. Opens the EPUBs and PDFs you own. No account, no server. Free, open source. iPhone, iPad, Mac.

name: Blume.codes
tagline: Turns coding agent sessions into better rules and skills
description: Blume watches your coding agent sessions locally and turns what it learns into better agent context. Repeated corrections become rules, workflows become skills, and your agents stop making the same mistakes. Claude code, Codex and Cursor.

name: Causal
tagline: AI Powered Canvas for planning visual projects
description: Enabling designers, creators, and founders to plan visual projects on an AI canvas. Key features: - Ask the AI to organise your ideas, brainstorm new directions, or create a roadmap from scratch - MCP connections so you can handoff your project to an external agent to turn into something real - Your images, inspiration, and notes all on a canvas with a native agent. - Create custom widgets - ask your agent to create a habit tracker on the canvas

name: Grove
tagline: One terminal for you and your AI agent
description: Grove is an AI-native macOS script runner designed to unify your terminal experience with your AI coding agent. It allows both you and your agent to control the same terminal processes, streamlining development workflows. Upon connecting a folder, Grove automatically sets up a menu bar, CLI, and a MCP server to manage real terminal processes. You can start, inspect, and stop these processes seamlessly.

name: ARBR
tagline: Control Every AI Request
description: AI stacks are getting more complex with more models, providers, costs, and decisions. ARBR gives your applications one control layer across your AI stack. Connect once through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint to route, govern, observe, evaluate, and deploy across AI models. Open source, MIT-licensed, provider-neutral, and self-hosted.

name: CodeLook
tagline: Quick Look code previews with 700+ editor themes
description: A Quick Look extension for macOS. Preview code files instantly with 700+ themes that match text editors, syntax highlighted via Tree-sitter. 100% private. One-time purchase.

name: Fillo
tagline: Build forms into your product with your coding agent
description: Build forms into your product with your coding agent. Fillo handles the infrastructure behind them: validation, uploads, responses, versions, and delivery.

name: Organizational Memory 2.0
tagline: Your enterprise just started thinking.
description: AI models start from zero every session, burning over 50% of enterprise token budgets on context retrieval. OM2 is the organizational memory that continuously learns your business across 50+ connectors, retiring outdated facts as new ones arrive. Your existing AI becomes 9x cheaper and 64% faster, with answers preferred 84.5% of the time. Pair OM2 with Optimized Routing for 51x cost savings. Works in Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, or custom agents via MCP or API.

name: ConvoData
tagline: Ask your marketing data anything. Then act on it.
description: Ask your Google Analytics, Search Console and Ads data a question in plain language. Get the answer, the evidence, and the next step.

name: Format
tagline: Customer analysis in minutes for decisions you can defend
description: Teams record more customer conversations than ever. Everyone has an analyst at hand in Claude. And somehow trust is down, people are fatigued, and decisions revert to gut or the loudest voice. Format pulls all of your customer conversations into one place, analyzes them and delivers customer insights, ready to use by agents for use cases across GTM, product and more. Custom Reports saves your analysis as a live report you can share, every claim backed by a quote you can play.

name: Webhub 1.0
tagline: Build your production-ready website. Get found in AI search
description: Webhub is an AI-native website and growth platform that helps small businesses build production-ready sites and keep growing them after launch. Create and publish your site, track search and AI visibility, turn insights into website improvements, capture leads, and follow up in one connected workflow. Every action creates data, every insight informs the next move, and growth compounds over time.
